newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danisco H1 pretax seen up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danisco H1 pretax seen up 8 pct.

text.p: Danish food and drinks group Danisco A/S is forecast to post a first-half 1996/97 pre-tax profit eight percent up on the same 1995/96 period, a Reuters poll of five analysts released on Monday showed.
The panel forecast that Danisco would report an average interim 844 million crown pre-tax profit, compared to 785 million crowns in 1995/96's first six months.

The estimates spanned from a low 815 million crowns to a high 870 million crowns pre-tax result for the period, on average expected turnover of 8.588 billion crowns, compared to the last first-half year's 7.826 billion crowns.
For the whole year 1996/97 the panel forecast an average pre-tax result of 1.819 billion crowns, spanning from 1.760-1.877 billion crowns, on average expected 17.869 billion crown sales.
The full year 1995/96 pre-tax profit estimate compared with 1.604 billion crowns for whole year 1995/96, a 13 percent increase against Danisco's own forecast of a 10-12 percent better result.
Danisco is due to unveil its 1996/97 first-half result on Wednesday December 18.
